scientific_integrity: The proof uses direct four-state spectral perturbation and exact sign inequalities; its accompanying symbolic and independent finite-time moment-chain checks are diagnostic rather than an independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotic one-particle fourth-cumulant rates, exact ensemble cumulants and no finite-sample stability theorem. The source model and full forward Fourier-Laplace representation were previously published.
title: Directional fourth-cumulant phases and reentrant reversal effects in a chiral four-state walker
